summary: GameSquare Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with its wholly owned subsidiary, Merger Sub 3, approved by stockholders at the 2026 Annual Meeting on June 18, 2026. The merger was completed immediately, with the company surviving. All outstanding common shares remained unchanged, while Merger Sub 3 shares were cancelled. Series A-1 Preferred Stock automatically converted into 1,000 common shares each, and Series A-2 Preferred Stock converted one-for-one into common shares. No price, premium, or advisor named. This appears to be a structural simplification and preferred share conversion, akin to a recapitalization or reorganization, not a third-party acquisition or going-private transaction. Watch for potential dilution from preferred conversions and any Nasdaq listing implications.
